info.title: RescueMesh Core API
info.description: RescueMesh Offline-First Backend & Event Verification Core

Designed for fast, zero-dependency health checks in local offline or containerized environments.

Actively probes database connectivity and explicitly exposes degraded offline operation

post.summary: Validate and verify a batch of RescueMesh events in memory
post.description:
In-memory validation of append-only events:
- Verifies SHA-256 canonical hash integrity.
- Inspects physical clock skew.
- Verifies ECDSA digital signature if public keys are supplied.
- Marks malformed or tampered events for quarantine without discarding them.

post.summary: Ingest, validate, and idempotently persist a batch of events
post.description:
Durable event ingestion endpoint:
- Performs cryptographic and canonical integrity verification.
- Idempotently persists valid events (duplicate events are silently skipped).
- Preserves historical observations (append-only, never overwriting).
- Quarantines invalid or tampered events in isolated storage.
- Automatically updates device registry and records synchronization ledger.

get.summary: List quarantined events for coordinator audit
get.description: Retrieve isolated quarantined events with forensic reasons and client IP.

schema.title: Response List Quarantined Events Api V1 Events Quarantined Get

get.summary: Retrieve single stored event by ID
get.description: Retrieve a single immutable event from the event store.

get.summary: List stored events with optional filtering
get.description: Query append-only events ordered by Hybrid Logical Clock wall time.

schema.title: Response List Events Api V1 Events Get

post.summary: Helper: Compute canonical bytes and SHA-256 event ID
post.description:
Utility endpoint allowing clients or test harnesses to compute the standard
RescueMesh canonical JSON byte sequence and SHA-256 content-addressed ID.

get.summary: Get compact event-ID summary of the local event store
get.description:
Returns compact summary of all persisted event IDs and the highest HLC wall time.
Used by offline peers to immediately compute which events need to be exchanged.

post.summary: Retrieve missing events based on peer's known event ID set
post.description:
Computes set difference (Server Events \ Peer Events) and returns missing full event records.
Transports can bundle this into JSON export or chunked QR codes.

post.summary: Export events as standard JSON or Deflate-compressed animated QR frames
post.description:
Exports events for offline transfer:
- 'chunked_qr': compresses into numbered Base64url QR frame sequence (Tier 0).
- 'json': produces raw export for file transfer or USB exchange.

post.summary: Import events from scanned QR frames or JSON payload
post.description:
Imports events via chunked QR or JSON:
- Progressively reassembles QR frames.
- If all frames are received, verifies integrity hash and idempotently persists events.

get.summary: List deterministically grouped incidents with priority scores
get.description:
Returns deterministically reconciled incident list.
Every priority score is calculated using S = 5V + 3P + 2C + 2R - 3U with safety clamp applied.

schema.title: Response List Incidents Api V1 Incidents Get

get.summary: Get full incident detail, conflict history, and priority explanation
get.description:
Returns full incident dossier:
- Current values selected by latest HLC.
- Preserved conflict history across all observers.
- Transparent factor breakdown (V, P, C, R, U) and explanation.

get.summary: Sensitivity analysis varying each weight by ±1
get.description:
Performs sensitivity analysis on the priority formula for this incident:
Varies weights by ±1 and reports whether the priority classification level remains stable.

get.summary: Get evidence-grounded responder briefing with Cite-or-Drop verification
get.description:
Generates an evidence-grounded responder briefing:
- Enforces Cite-or-Drop verification: uncorroborated claims and figures are dropped.
- Seamlessly falls back to deterministic rule-based template if offline or unconfigured.

post.summary: Upload image evidence with automatic EXIF metadata stripping
post.description:
Evidence Image Upload Endpoint:
- Accepts direct binary image streams or JSON Base64 payloads (zero external multipart dependency).
- Strips privacy-sensitive EXIF metadata (GPS coordinates, camera model, timestamps).
- Computes content-addressed SHA-256 hash of cleaned bytes.
- Saves sanitized image for local offline storage or mesh transmission.
- Returns the content-addressed evidence_hash ready for inclusion in event payload.evidence_hashes.

get.summary: Retrieve sanitized evidence image by SHA-256 hash
get.description: Serve sanitized evidence file by content address.

HybridLogicalClock.title: HybridLogicalClock
HybridLogicalClock.description:
Hybrid Logical Clock representation:
- wall_time_ms: Physical UTC timestamp in milliseconds
- logical_counter: Tie-breaking sequence counter on the node
- node_id: Unique identifier of the node (typically device_id)

RescueMeshEvent.title: RescueMeshEvent
RescueMeshEvent.description:
Immutable, content-addressed append-only RescueMesh event.
- event_id: SHA-256 hex of canonical (clock, device_id, event_type, payload)
- signature: ECDSA signature over the canonical content

dropped_claims.title: Dropped Claims
